categories.name: White Core
categories.useCase: Original artwork, photography, quality prints — everyday professional framing.
categories.specBar: 1.4mm · Alpha cellulose · Acid-free · Lignin-free · White bevel stays white · FATG Level 3
categories.description: White Core is the most widely used mount board in professional framing. The core is chemically purified — the bevel stays bright white for the life of the frame. Suitable for original artwork, photography, and quality prints at all price points.

categories.name: Black Core
categories.useCase: Photography, graphic prints, contemporary art — the black bevel adds depth and drama.
categories.tagline: A dramatic black bevel — bold contrast for modern framing
categories.specBar: 1.4mm · 100% recycled fibres · Carbon black core · Acid-free · Lignin-free · FATG Level 4
categories.description: Black Core mounts reveal a deep black bevel when cut. The black edge is visible between the surface and the artwork, creating a natural shadow that makes the image appear to float. Popular for photography, graphic prints, and contemporary art.

categories.name: Conservation
categories.useCase: Original art, limited editions, vintage photographs — permanent archival protection.
categories.tagline: Permanent archival protection for artwork that matters
categories.specBar: 1.4mm · Alpha cellulose · Acid-free · Calcium carbonate buffered · No optical brighteners · FATG Level 2
categories.description: Conservation mounts are the professional standard for original artwork, limited-edition prints, and vintage photographs. Buffered with calcium carbonate to actively resist acid migration. The bevel stays permanently white. No optical brighteners — will not change colour under UV light.

categories.name: Extra Thick
categories.useCase: Gallery framing and special commissions — the 2.6mm bevel is a design statement in itself.
categories.tagline: A deep 2.6mm bevel — the gallery framing choice
categories.specBar: 2.6mm · Alpha cellulose · Acid-free · Lignin-free · Nearly double standard thickness · FATG Level 3
categories.description: At 2.6mm — almost double the standard thickness — Extra Thick mounts deliver a sculptural bevel that catches light differently and signals quality at a glance. Used in gallery framing and special commissions where the mount is part of the design statement.

categories.name: Museum
categories.useCase: Irreplaceable originals, museum pieces, archival documents — 100% cotton rag, the absolute standard.
categories.tagline: The gold standard — 100% cotton rag, naturally acid-free
categories.specBar: 1.4mm · 100% cotton rag · Naturally acid-free · Pigment colouring only · No optical brighteners · FATG Level 1
categories.description: Museum mounts are made from 100% cotton rag — not wood pulp — so they are naturally acid-free without any chemical treatment. Used in museums and national galleries for the permanent preservation of irreplaceable artwork, documents, and photographs. Pigment-only colouring ensures the face will not fade under prolonged light exposure.

categories.name: Suede
categories.useCase: Portrait photography, wedding commissions, textile art — tactile velvet-like fabric surface.
categories.tagline: A soft tactile surface — warmth and texture in the mount
categories.specBar: 1.4mm · Suedette fabric surface · White core beneath · pH neutral · FATG Level 3
categories.description: Suede mounts carry a soft velvet-like fabric surface that no standard board can replicate. The tactile quality works especially well for portrait photography, wedding commissions, and textile art — anywhere the mount itself is part of the design rather than a neutral border.
